if (grepl("\\.\\.\\.", .user_code)) {
  gradethis::fail("It looks like you haven't filled in the blanks yet — replace the `...` with your code.")
}


# code_feedback() itself can error, e.g. when the user's call has fewer arguments than the solution's
.msg <- tryCatch(
  gradethis::code_feedback(),
  error = function(e) "Your code gives a different result than expected. Have a look at the hint and try again."
)
if (is.null(.msg)) {
  # code matches the solution exactly
  gradethis::pass_if_equal()
  gradethis::pass()  # charitable pass if result differs but code matches
} else {
  # code differs from solution
  gradethis::pass_if_equal(
    message = "Excellent work! Your solution works, but is different from ours. If you're curious, use `ⓘ Show solution` to compare your solution with ours (you may have to click `💡 Show hint` first)."
  )
  gradethis::fail(.msg, hint = FALSE)
}
